title: Ability
description: Something a species brings (#222): a special attack the player triggers (#221), a passive that helps the player while the companion is active, or one that helps the companion itself. A special attack is one species' own (#228). One file per ability, named after its id.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

description.description: What it does, for the player.

power.description: A special's: how much of its species' strength one strike deals, in thousandths (#33, #410): 3000 is three times it.

cooldown_seconds.description: A special's: the seconds before it can fire again (#410).
